sentences.text: `` Battle of the Bastards '' is the ninth episode of the sixth season of HBO 's fantasy television series Game of Thrones , and its 59th episode overall .	Game of Thrones	Game of Thrones	sixth season	Game of Thrones (season 6)	HBO	HBO	fantasy	fantasy
It was written by series co-creators David Benioff and D. B. Weiss , and directed by Miguel Sapochnik .	Miguel Sapochnik	Miguel Sapochnik	David Benioff	David Benioff	D. B. Weiss	D. B. Weiss

In the North , the armies of the eponymous bastards , Jon Snow -LRB- Kit Harington -RRB- and Ramsay Bolton -LRB- Iwan Rheon -RRB- , face off in a battle for control of Winterfell .	the North	World of A Song of Ice and Fire#The North	Jon Snow	Jon Snow (character)	Kit Harington	Kit Harington	Ramsay Bolton	Ramsay Bolton	Iwan Rheon	Iwan Rheon	Winterfell	World of A Song of Ice and Fire#Winterfell
The Bolton army defeats most of Jon 's forces , largely composed of Wildlings .	Wildlings	World of A Song of Ice and Fire#Night's Watch and Wildlings

However , Sansa Stark -LRB- Sophie Turner -RRB- arrives with Petyr Baelish -LRB- Aidan Gillen -RRB- and the Knights of the Vale and they defeat the remaining Bolton army .	Sansa Stark	Sansa Stark	Sophie Turner	Sophie Turner	Petyr Baelish	Petyr Baelish	Aidan Gillen	Aidan Gillen
Ramsay retreats to Winterfell , where Jon beats him into the mud , locks him in the kennels and Sansa feeds him to his own hounds .	Winterfell	World of A Song of Ice and Fire#Winterfell

In Meereen , Daenerys Targaryen -LRB- Emilia Clarke -RRB- refuses to surrender to the Masters , mounts Drogon and begins burning the Masters ' fleet ; this forces them to surrender .	Meereen	World of A Song of Ice and Fire#Meereen	Daenerys Targaryen	Daenerys Targaryen	Emilia Clarke	Emilia Clarke

Yara -LRB- Gemma Whelan -RRB- and Theon Greyjoy -LRB- Alfie Allen -RRB- arrive in Meereen and offer their ships to Daenerys , swearing to help her take the Seven Kingdoms .	Gemma Whelan	Gemma Whelan	Meereen	World of A Song of Ice and Fire#Meereen	Yara	Yara Greyjoy	Theon Greyjoy	Theon Greyjoy	Alfie Allen	Alfie Allen
`` Battle of the Bastards '' was praised as one of the series ' best episodes , with several reviewers hailing it as a `` masterpiece '' .

Critics described the battle in the North as `` terrifying , gripping and exhilarating '' and Daenerys 's reunion with her dragons at the beginning of the episode as `` thrilling '' .	the North	World of A Song of Ice and Fire#The North
Its eponymous battle took 25 days to film and required 500 extras , 600 crew members and 70 horses .
In the United States , the episode had a viewership of 7.66 million in its initial broadcast .	had a viewership	Nielsen ratings

It earned Game of Thrones several Primetime Emmy Awards -LRB- including Outstanding Directing and Outstanding Writing -RRB- , and was Harington 's choice to support his nomination for the Outstanding Supporting Actor ; Sapochnik also won the Directors Guild of America Award for Outstanding Directing in a Drama Series for the episode .
